demonstration.narration: Traffic is steady, but this dashboard only counts requests with http.route. I'll search schema.route_present: false for missing routes, then check their producer and version.
demonstration.evidence: The hit count now shows only requests recorded without a route. One of them should show which producer and version sent requests without http.route.

demonstration.narration: I'll open one missing-route request to check its producer and version together. That shows who sent a request without http.route.
demonstration.evidence: This one request has no route, and it was sent by ${param.incident.producer} on version ${param.incident.version}. ${truth.conclusion}
